# Smart Remote Gigs

> > A curated platform connecting remote job seekers with vetted work-from-home opportunities, plus productivity tools and software reviews for distributed teams.

Smart Remote Gigs specializes in entry-level remote job listings, offering a curated job board alongside free tools for resume optimization, interview preparation, and productivity. The site also features in-depth reviews of remote work software including AI tools like ElevenLabs.

## Key Topics

- Remote jobs and work-from-home opportunities
- Entry-level positions and job search strategies
- Curated job listings and job boards
- Resume optimization and ATS compatibility
- Interview preparation techniques
- ElevenLabs AI voice generation and text-to-speech
- Voice cloning and conversational AI
- Productivity tools for remote workers
- Freelancer resources and tools
- AI-powered software reviews
- Speech-to-text and AI music generation
- SEO and content optimization
- Pomodoro technique and time management

## Job Board & Career Resources

- [The Smart Remote Job Board: Find Vetted WFH Jobs (2026)](https://smartremotegigs.com/jobs): Curated job board featuring vetted entry-level remote work opportunities

## Remote Work Tools & Utilities

- [Free Tools for Remote Workers & Freelancers](https://smartremotegigs.com/tools): Free productivity, writing, finance & job hunting tools for remote workers

## Software Reviews & Guides

- [ElevenLabs Review 2026: Pricing, Features & Alternatives](https://smartremotegigs.com/software/elevenlabs): ElevenLabs AI voice platform review covering pricing, features & alternatives
